INTERNAL MEMORANDUM.

From... B.24.G. .............................................  To... B.7. Aitkin-Sneath

Seen, thank you. I believe Miller first met GROEHL in Paris, and GROEHL gave him to understand, I gather, that he was in touch with the British Intelligence Service. He met him again in London last autumn and made it clear that he was still in touch with "certain quarters".

Date... 21.7.41. ........  Signature... W.D. Robson-Scott.

S. Form 161
